/// <summary>
/// SG-generated retention job for <see cref="ReservationAttachment"/>: removes the stored file and then the metadata row of attachments soft-deleted more than 30 day(s) ago.
/// </summary>
[RecurringJob("0 3 * * *", Id = "purge-reservation-attachments")]
public sealed partial class PurgeReservationAttachmentsJob : IJob
{
    private readonly DbContext _db;
    private readonly IFileStorage _storage;
    private readonly IClock _clock;
    private readonly global::Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger<PurgeReservationAttachmentsJob> _logger;
    
    public PurgeReservationAttachmentsJob(
        [global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.FromKeyedServices(typeof(global::Showcase.Booking.BookingBoundary))] DbContext db,
        IFileStorage storage,
        IClock clock,
        global::Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger<PurgeReservationAttachmentsJob> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _storage = storage;
        _clock = clock;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes the stored files first — the derived thumbnail, then the original — and the row second, for every expired attachment.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task ExecuteAsync(JobContext context, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var cutoff = _clock.UtcNow.AddDays(-30);
        
        var expired = await _db.Set<ReservationAttachment>()
            .IgnoreQueryFilters()
            .Where(a => a.IsDeleted && a.DeletedAt != null && a.DeletedAt < cutoff)
            .ToListAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        
        if (expired.Count == 0)
            return;
        
        var purged = 0;
        foreach (var attachment in expired)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            
            try
            {
                if (attachment.ThumbnailUri is not null)
                {
                    await _storage.DeleteAsync(new Uri(attachment.ThumbnailUri, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute), ct)
                        .ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                
                await _storage.DeleteAsync(new Uri(attachment.StorageUri, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute), ct)
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    ex,
                    "Purge of ReservationAttachment {AttachmentId} left its stored files in place; the row is kept and will be retried.",
                    attachment.Id);
                continue;
            }
            
            _db.Remove(attachment);
            purged++;
        }
        
        if (purged > 0)
        {
            using (global::Pragmatic.Persistence.Entity.SoftDeleteScope.Suspend())
            {
                await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Purged {PurgedCount} of {ExpiredCount} expired ReservationAttachment rows.",
                purged, expired.Count);
        }
    }
